name: protsenko-hub
description: Family hub: calendar, shopping, children tasks, sleep, contacts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @protsenko/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.sync:mobile: npm run build:mobile && npm run sync -w mobile
scripts.sync:mobile:android: npm run build:mobile && npm run sync:android -w mobile
scripts.sync:mobile:ios: npm run build:mobile && npm run sync:ios -w mobile
scripts.run:mobile:android: npm run sync:mobile:android && npm run run:android -w mobile
scripts.run:mobile:ios: npm run sync:mobile:ios && npm run run:ios -w mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @protsenko/shared && npm exec -w api -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && npm exec -w web -- ng build --configuration=development
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm exec -w api -- prisma db seed
scripts.db:deploy: node ./scripts/with-database-env.js npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
